claims.hypothesis: Are methyl isocyanate (CH3NCO) and methanethiol (CH3SH) present in the hot core G31.41+0.31?
claims.experiment: Line identification of the Band 3 spectra with CASSIS using CDMS/JPL catalogs, LTE model spectra and Gaussian line fits
claims.result: Six v_b=0 and one v_b=1 CH3NCO transitions, and three CH3SH spectral profiles with multiple transitions, were identified
claims.finding: First detection of CH3NCO and CH3SH in G31

evidence.quote: We report first detection of CH$_3$NCO and CH$_3$SH in G31 and discuss the kinematics associated with this HMC.
Altogether, we have identified six transitions of CH$_3$NCO with the ground vibrational state ($v_b=0$) and one transition with $v_b=1$.

claims.hypothesis: Are multiple temperature components present in the hot core?
claims.experiment: Rotation-diagram fits of CH3OH, CH3OCHO, CH3SH and CH3NCO transitions
claims.result: CH3OH and CH3NCO give 33-48 K; CH3SH, CH3OH (hot) and CH3OCHO give about 143-181 K
claims.finding: A cold and a hot component are suggested, though they are only marginally resolved and cannot be located spatially

evidence.quote: We obtained two temperature components by using rotation diagram analysis.

claims.hypothesis: Do the COM abundances in G31 resemble those in other hot cores, implying similar formation (grain/ice) pathways?
claims.experiment: LTE column densities and abundances for CH3OH, CH3SH, CH3OCHO, CH3NCO compared with Sgr B2(N), Orion KL, G10.47+0.03 and a hot-core chemical model
claims.result: G31 abundances are comparable to those of the other hot cores, with CH3SH and CH3OCHO/CH3OH ratios differing in places
claims.finding: COMs are favourably produced in hot-core conditions and possibly on grain/ice phase; gas and grain contributions cannot be separated with these data

evidence.quote: Our observed abundances of COMs in G31 are consistent with other hot cores, Sgr B2, Orion KL, and G10.47+0.03, which suggests similar formation mechanisms of these complex species in these sources.
However, we can not distinguish the contribution from the gas and grain phase separately due to the observational limit.

claims.hypothesis: Do HCN, H13CO+ and SiO trace infall and outflow in G31?
claims.experiment: Spectral profiles of H13CO+, HCN and SiO, RADEX modelling, and SiO/HCN blue and red lobe maps with outflow parameter estimates
claims.result: Red-shifted H13CO+ absorption with infall velocity 4.5 km/s; SiO and HCN outflows along E-W (and N-S) with dynamical time ~3-4e3 yr (7.9 kpc)
claims.finding: The source shows infall and young, massive outflows

evidence.quote: Protostellar outflows are traced by SiO and HCN.
The infall velocity of the source is obtained to be 4.5 km s$^{-1}$.

referee_caveats_inferred: Internal inconsistencies: CH3SH rotation temperature given as 76 K in Section 3.3 but the Conclusions place CH3SH in a 143-181 K hot component; text gives CH3SH column density 4.13e-17 versus 4.13(17) in the Table; text says rotation-diagram CH3NCO column density is one order higher than LTE, but the Table lists a lower rotation-diagram value
Tex = 150 K is assumed in the CASSIS models even though the CH3NCO and CH3SH rotation temperatures are 48 K and 76 K; the choice of Tex strongly changes column densities
LTE best fit judged by eye; no uncertainties on column densities or abundances and no detection significance for the new species
Many CH3NCO and CH3SH lines are blended (including with ethylene glycol) and the beam is comparable to the source size, so the identification and emitting sizes are uncertain
Large distance ambiguity (7.9 versus 3.7 kpc) changes source size, mass and outflow results
Calibration and imaging recipe is not described, so continuum and line flux scale cannot be verified

evidence.quote: In this paper, we used Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) cycle 3 archival data (#2015.1.01193.S) to study COMs in G31.

missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, masks, line-free channels, primary beam correction)
Whether archive-calibrated products or a re-run calibration was used
Per-line CASSIS model parameters (Tex, source size, FWHM, V_LSR, N) beyond what appears in a table not included in the text
Exact definition of outflow lobe velocity ranges and length measurements
RADEX solutions read from contour plots
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Four spectral windows of ~0.47 GHz in one Band 3 execution of 12 m array data; likely tens of GB for raw archive download, a few GB for calibrated MS
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public and the spectral analysis (Gaussian fits, rotation diagrams, CASSIS LTE with fixed parameters) is described and gives numeric results, but calibration and imaging details are missing and Tex/uncertainties are loosely specified.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, an extraction aperture and line list are given, and the main results are numeric (temperatures, column densities, abundances), but imaging details must be chosen by the reproducer.
